name: gnosis
description: 灵知 (Gnosis) — 本地知识库。聚合 npm scripts 入口，包 Python (server/) + Electron (desktop/)。

scripts.test:unit: cd server && KB_MILVUS_URI=./kb_milvus_lite.db python3 -m pytest -p no:warnings tests/
scripts.test:integration: cd server && KB_MILVUS_URI=./kb_milvus_lite.db python3 -m pytest -p no:warnings
scripts.eval: cd server && PYTHONPATH=. python3 eval/run_eval.py --embedder openai-compat
scripts.eval:mock: cd server && PYTHONPATH=. python3 eval/run_eval.py --embedder mock
scripts.eval:bgem3: cd server && PYTHONPATH=. python3 eval/run_eval.py --embedder bge-m3
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
